verdict.rationale: Signifyd lists a 'Chargeback Recovery' product. Its API lets merchants record Chargeback events and Representment Outcome events against orders, which implies a representment workflow tied to the order data Signifyd already holds. However, nothing in the evidence describes automated evidence compilation or submission to issuers. Missing for 10: documentation that evidence is auto-compiled from order, delivery and session/device data; automated submission of responses to issuers; any description of how the representment workflow runs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
